purpose: Forensic audit + alpha validation of P1/P2/P3 (see docs/audits/FORENSIC_AUDIT_2026-10-03.md). All results are PAPER / SIMULATION; none is a live track record.
code_commit_audited: daa6eaf0 (origin/main at audit start; engine code identical to 19148d9 of 2026-07-04 — every later commit was a bot state write)
how_to_reproduce: Run from the repo root with config/portfolios.json present (paper keys, read-only GETs). Working dir /tmp/audit_2026_10_03 (create it; broker_forensics/fetch_broker.py writes /tmp/audit_2026_10_03/broker). Order: broker_forensics/fetch_broker.py -> roundtrips.py -> expectancy.py, perf.py, attrib.py; momentum_oos/fetch.py -> task1_oos.py, task2_robust.py; signal_ic/extract.py -> prices.py -> p1.py, p3.py, robust.py; p2_forensics/*. Research tier T2 (offline); never imported by the trading path.

datasets.broker_truth: Alpaca paper accounts PA3HULQQ8OOH / PA38R564MIS7 / PA3M3WI7C58W: /v2/account, /v2/positions, /v2/account/portfolio/history (1D, period 1A; timestamps are 00:00 UTC = prior trading day ET), all FILL activities, all orders. Pulled 2026-10-03.
datasets.benchmark: SPY, QQQ, IWM, RSP, AGG, BIL daily bars, adjustment=all, IEX feed, 2026-05-01..2026-10-02
datasets.momentum_history: Alpaca SIP daily bars 2017-03..2026-10 for config/universe_wide.json (115 names); signals on split-adjusted closes, P&L on fully adjusted prices; GE 2021 reverse split and GE/RTX spin-off adjustment errors corrected (see artifacts/t2_main.out)
datasets.signal_snapshots: Point-in-time data/signals.json, event-driven-bot/data/signals.json and news_signals.json reconstructed from git history: first commit >= 13:30 UTC whose internal timestamp is that day; 89 P1 days, 89 P3 days, 27 news days; entry next-day open
datasets.p2_feed: political-copy-bot journals, processed/skip ledgers and Actions logs 2026-07-06..2026-10-02

cost_assumptions: 5 bps per side base; 10/20 bps and 2x/4x shocks reported; cash earns BIL

multiple_testing.composition: 180 parameter-surface configs (k x lookback x max_per_sector x vol_target) + 60 data/trial_ledger.json entries + 22 prior momentum variants in scripts/research/high_return_backtest.py

artifacts.perf_summary.json: broker-verified return/beta/TE/IR/maxDD per book vs SPY
artifacts.attrib.json: daily excess-return decomposition: selection / cash-beta drag / trading residual
artifacts.roundtrips.json: FIFO round trips from broker fills (reconciles exactly to broker positions) joined to trade-log exit reasons
artifacts.res_p1.json, res_p3.json, p1_out.txt, p3: live point-in-time signal IC / quintiles / factor IC
artifacts.copy_quality.json, attrib_daily.json, fe: P2 copy-sleeve quality, attribution and disclosure-feed health
